Word of God for the Week 12/11/2026 - As we continue to rejoice throughout this month of November, our song shall be - “O Lord, You are my God. I will exalt You, I will praise Your name, For You have done wonderful things; Your counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.” (Isaiah 25:1). The Almighty God has promised us that “His glory shall be revealed in us, and all flesh shall see it together; and because the mouth of the Lord has spoken.” It shall be so amen (Isaiah 40:5). So let’s continue to offer the sacrifice of praise to our God, which is the fruit of our lips (Heb 13:15), giving thanks to His holy name; and putting all our trust & hope in Him (Jer 17:7-8). He will also continue to lift up the light & glory of His face upon us (Psalm 4:6-8; 89:15-18; Numbers 6:24-27; overflowing our hearts with joy, (1 Peter 1:8); joy unspeakable full of His glory in the mighty name of Jesus Christ Amen!

Sent from my iPhone - please excuse any typographical errors

Ernest Ogbe
RCCG-SGLG
